Name: Pokemon Editor and QoL Mod
Author: PointDexter24
Description:
[img width=316,height=316]https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_ef9d35fe-64e3-4f48-babb-fce4989191ad.png[/img]

I'm a very big fan of Pokemon and also stardew valley, that's why I'm very greatful to the mod makers. What started as a little side project for my own save file, I’m sharing with everyone. This mod adds an in-game [b]Pokémon Editor[/b] for [b]Pelipper Town[/b], letting you tweak your Pokémon without having to dig through save files or the very limited pokemon customization within the game.
From the editor, you can change things like your Pokémon’s [b]Nature, Gender, Level, Bond, EVs, IVs, Passive, Type Affinity, Moves, and Shiny status[/b], while still using Pelipper Town’s own Pokémon systems underneath. You can also heal and restore your Pokémon, edit their moves, or generate a new Pokémon directly into your party.
I also added a few optional [b]QoL cheats[/b] for people who just want a more relaxed or customizable playthrough. You can enable things like [b]100% catch rate, all wild Pokémon spawning shiny, fewer or no random encounters, stronger encounter rates[/b], and quickly give yourself Poké Balls when needed. Where possible, these features reuse Pelipper Town’s own mechanics instead of replacing them with completely separate systems.
The goal is simple: give players an easy way to customize their Pokémon and their experience without constantly leaving the game, editing files, or fighting with commands.
As the name suggests: [b]Pelipper Town mod, Pokémon Editor.[/b]

[heading]🎮 How It Works[/heading]
[list]
[*][list]
[*]Open the [b]Pokémon Editor[/b] in-game and select the Pokémon you want to modify.[/*]
[*]You can edit your Pokémon’s [b]Nature, Gender, Level, Bond, EVs, IVs, Passive, Type Affinity, Moves, and Shiny status[/b].[/*]
[*]You can also [b]heal your Pokémon and restore its energy[/b] directly from the editor.[/*]
[*]The [b]Move Editor[/b] lets you change your Pokémon’s equipped moves and choose new ones from the move selector.[/*]
[*]The [b]Pokémon Generator[/b] lets you create a Pokémon and add it directly to your party. Just make sure you have an available party slot first.[/*]
[*]Changes are only applied once you press [b]Apply[/b], so you can adjust everything first before committing your edits.[/*]
[*]The mod also includes optional [b]QoL cheats[/b], including:
[list]
[*][b]100% Catch Rate[/b][/*]
[*][b]All Wild Pokémon Shiny[/b][/*]
[*][b]No Random Wild Encounters[/b][/*]
[*][b]More Random Wild Encounters[/b][/*]
[*][b]Give Poké Balls[/b][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Enabling [b]All Wild Pokémon Shiny[/b] refreshes the current wild Pokémon, so newly spawned Pokémon will appear shiny.[/*]
[*][b]No Random Wild Encounters[/b] stops random wild Pokémon from appearing.[/*]
[*][b]More Random Wild Encounters[/b] greatly increases how often wild Pokémon appear.[/*]
[*][b]Give Poké Balls[/b] lets you quickly add Poké Balls when you need them.[/*]
[*]All QoL options are optional, so if you only want the Pokémon editor itself, you can simply leave them disabled.[/*]
[/list]Basically, edit what you want, keep what you like, and play Pelipper Town the way you want.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][img width=850,height=553]https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_ec74adb4-6fcc-4648-91bb-c887885a1455.png[/img][/heading]
  

[heading]⚠️ Notes[/heading]
[list]
[*]📦 Place the [b]Pelipper Town Pokémon Editor[/b] folder inside your Stardew Valley 
[code]Mods[/code] folder.[/*]
[*]⚠️ Make sure you already have [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Pelipper Town 1.2.0 or later[/b] installed. [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] is optional.[/*]
[*]💾 Back up your save before using the mod, especially before making major changes to your Pokémon.[/*]
[*]✅ Once in-game, press [b]F8[/b] to open the [b]Pokémon Editor[/b] and get started.[/*]
[*]⚙️ You can change the editor hotkey through [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] or the mod's 
[code]config.json[/code] if you prefer a different key.[/*]
[/list][line]
